summary.name: JDownloader
summary.one_liner: JDownloader is a free, open-source download manager for links, files and hosted content.
summary.what_it_does: JDownloader is described as a free, open-source download management tool with a large community. Users can start, stop or pause downloads, set bandwidth limits, and auto-extract archives. The page says it is an easy-to-extend framework. The page also lists add-ons, browser integration, and a Wiki/FAQ, though it gives no detail on these beyond their names.
notable: Pause, stop and resume downloads with bandwidth limits
caveats: Platforms are not named on the page text provided
Page is mostly a news and navigation listing with limited technical detail
